title: Japanese Eggplant Zaalouk Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Japanese and Moroccan flavors, this eggplant zaalouk stir fry is a quick and easy dinner option.

ingredients.name: Umami Miso Paste
ingredients.notes: Combine with soy sauce for marinade

ingredients.name: Moroccan Zaalouk Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Use to add flavor to the eggplant

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.notes: Combine with miso paste for marinade

ingredients.name: Rice Vinegar
ingredients.notes: Add a splash of acidity to the dish

instructions: Marinate the eggplant slices in a mixture of miso paste, soy sauce, and rice vinegar for at least 15 minutes.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the eggplant slices to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes, until tender and lightly browned.
Add the Moroccan zaalouk spice blend and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve the eggplant zaalouk hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
Optional: Serve over steamed rice or noodles for a filling meal.
